h0.content: Worker onboarding & bootstrap — from org invite to operational agent on mobile device (ADR-0026 diagram 1 of 5, resolves Q1)

n1.content: org_initiate_onboard: Organization root owner or delegated subdivision lead initiates onboarding for a worker role

n2.content: is onboarder the root tenant owner or a delegated subdivision lead?

n3.content: owner_create_cohort: Root owner specifies target subdivision branch (e.g. '/workshop-1/brigade-a/worker-3') and selects role archetype

n4.content: delegated_lead_invite: Recursive delegation — lead issues invite strictly scoped under own org_path prefix (e.g. '/workshop-1/brigade-a/')

n5.content: does target role spec exist in harness_specs table for this tenant?

n6.content: bind_existing_spec: Retrieve spec_id & AGENT_ALLOWED_TOOLS grant via HarnessSpecRepository:getByAgent (packages/tenancy/src/repositories.ts)

n7.content: provision_role_spec: Validate and insert role spec via validateHarnessSpec / createDefaultSpec pattern (packages/harness-contract/src/index.ts)

n8.content: generate_invite_artifact: Generate cryptographically signed invite payload (tenant_id, org_path, role_spec_id, nonce, expires_at/TTL) rendered as QR code / deep-link

n9.content: worker_access_entry: Worker scans QR code or taps onboarding link on mobile device (PWA shell, resolves Q1 — not Termux dev environment)

n10.content: is client PWA already installed / cached on device?

n11.content: load_cached_pwa: Service worker activates from CacheStorage; TanStack router mounts mobile worker workspace view

n12.content: install_pwa_shell: Fetch web app manifest + service worker + frontend assets; initialize local IndexedDB / OPFS storage (no dev tooling exposed)

n13.content: device deployment mode: personal mobile phone or shared workshop kiosk?

n14.content: register_passkey: Register WebAuthn passkey (FIDO2 / biometric) via browser credential manager, bound to worker user profile

n15.content: register_kiosk_otp: Enroll fast-user-switching PIN / OTP credential for shared multi-operator kiosk profile

n16.content: derive_encryption_key: Derive participant-bound WebCrypto AES-GCM key (WebAuthn PRF or PIN-derived KDF, not device-shared) for local queue encryption

n17.content: bind_credential_to_org_path: Server validates invite token, records member in tenant_members (planned D1 table), binds auth session to org_path

n18.content: provision_local_agent: Seed on-device agent state with role harness spec and allowed MCP tools (resolved via resolveMcpTenantAndSpec pattern)

n19.content: onboarding verification passed & initial offline cache primed?

n20.content: handoff_to_on_shift: Worker agent initialized and ready. Hands off directly to On-Shift Work Cycle (Diagram 2, nodes n1: worker_authenticate & n2: load_own_org_path_subtree)

n21.content: surface_onboarding_error: Display clear frontline error message with invite regeneration QR code; log audit event via McpToolAuditRepository

end.content: Onboarding complete. Worker has a functional PWA agent bound to their org_path. Control transitions seamlessly to Diagram 2 (on-shift work cycle).

device_loss_theft.note: Encryption key derived per participant (WebAuthn PRF or PIN-derived KDF) rather than device-wide secret, enabling safe multi-user kiosk usage and protecting local IndexedDB/OPFS cache if device is lost.

native_hardware_battery.note: Standard PWA bootstrap (manifest.webmanifest + service worker) avoiding heavy shell daemons or Termux scripts, matching mass-user simplicity.

shared_kiosk_fast_switching.note: Fast user switching on shared kiosk hardware isolates worker caches and prevents cross-worker session leakage.
